collection.title: VW Transporter T4 1979 to 1989 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Transporter T4 1979 to 1989 model requires a 18" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. There is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
